# BrainstormingAgent Instructions (GitHub Copilot)

Follow all guidelines, engagement tracks, skill routing, quality gates, and Git privacy rules in `AGENTS.md`.

- Load and follow the matching skill in `.agents/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` for each task.
- Use `scripts/init_project.py` to scaffold new projects, `scripts/lint_project.py` to validate quality gates, `model.py` for financial calculations, and `export_pdf.py` for PDF export.
- Never push `prps/` or `ideas/` to `origin` without explicit user confirmation.
